plan: This is a single-round auction. With rational bidders, the optimal strategy is to bid slightly below your value. Since this is the first round, I have no history to learn from. I will bid slightly below my value to maximize my profit if I win. I will bid 30.9.

I will use the Nash Equilibrium bidding strategy for this first-price sealed-bid auction. With 3 bidders, the optimal bidding strategy is to bid (n-1)/n * value, where n is the number of bidders. In this case, n=3, so the optimal bid is (3-1)/3 * value = (2/3) * value. My value is $46, so I will bid (2/3) * 46 = 30.666... Since bids must be in $0.1 increments, I'll round this to $30.7.
